concepts.label: 01 — Mountain valley
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one square premium logo concept presentation for "AquaLight", an aquarium lighting controller app. Core symbol: a recognizable wide rounded rectangular aquarium with a SHORT LED LIGHT BAR ABOVE the rim, casting a broad controlled beam of DAYLIGHT onto a beautiful aquascape. A small sun disk with a few short rays near the overhead light communicates that this lamp replaces the sun.
CRITICAL USER DIRECTION: The aquarium interior must be a genuinely composed, attractive AQUASCAPE with asymmetry, layered terrain, planting masses and purposeful open space. It must NOT contain a single boring generic plant sprig. Specific landscape for this concept: An intentional nature-aquarium composition: a tall dramatic cluster of angular stone peaks on the LEFT, densely planted slopes and low carpeting plants descending into an open pale negative-space sand path that curves toward the RIGHT. Smaller stones on the right give depth. Beautiful asymmetric underwater mountain valley. No solitary sprig.
Keep a logo designer's discipline: simplified bold vector silhouettes, 3–5 meaningful large landscape masses, strong negative space, no fine botanical illustration or photorealism. Interior detail should feel like a beautiful miniature landscape while retaining clarity. Tank shape is a wide elegant horizontal rectangle with softened corners, not a jar or fishbowl. The light bar, sunlight beam and aquascape together make the app purpose obvious.
Palette: midnight violet #0B0718 flat background, vivid pink #FF0A5C for tank/lighting emblem, restrained coral and lavender for landscape layers, pearl white #F7F2FF wordmark. No atmospheric glow or textures.
Composition: large emblem upper centre, exact wordmark "AquaLight" below in rounded contemporary grotesque semibold, descriptor "Aquarium light control" below that, small muted concept label "01 — Mountain valley" bottom left. Bottom right: a small pink rounded-square app icon showing a SIMPLIFIED WHITE VERSION OF THE SAME TANK AND LANDSCAPE SILHOUETTE, not a lone plant. Consistent polished presentation. No photos, no 3D, no merch mockups, no water-drop symbol, no extra logo options on the board.
